name: Susi Startsignal
personality: She is ready before the signal and suspicious immediately after it.
visual_intent: Narrow tapered ink blob fully upright, little swept crest, lashed huge alert eyes and tiny trembling CLOSED smile; cream sweatband and small rust bib; two small wooden starting-block wedges held together in hands like precious documents, no running legs
biography: She is ready before the signal and suspicious immediately after it. She holds the starting blocks like an application that must never be submitted too early. HyperNorm classifies anticipation as enthusiasm until it becomes a false start. A dissonant card has taught her to let a nervous neighbour stand beside her. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie ist startbereit. Bitte erschrecken Sie sie jetzt nicht mit dem Start.

name: Hektor Hürde
personality: He regards each obstacle as a clerical repetition of the previous one.
visual_intent: Very tall bent bell ink blob, low annoyed side glance, long toothless closed grumble; rust headband and tiny cream collar; holds miniature single simple wooden hurdle frame beside flank fully inside cell, no track
biography: He regards each obstacle as a clerical repetition of the previous one. He carries a small hurdle to demonstrate that obstacles are repeatable and therefore probably intentional. The building files residents as cleared or pending. He has started wondering whether removing a barrier might count as a respectable performance. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die nächste Hürde ist dieselbe. Das spart Einarbeitung.

name: Gitta Gewichtung
personality: She prefers arguments that can be weighed in one hand.
visual_intent: Very broad round scalloped blob, strong modest lashes and fierce delighted grin with three upper teeth INSIDE mouth; small rust neckerchief and cream wrist wrap; holds ONE dark iron shot-put sphere close to shoulder in open palm, other palm at flank
biography: She prefers arguments that can be weighed in one hand. She weighs the shot in her palm because the association accepts only heavy arguments or light-mindedness. A dissonant card points out that a gentle question can change a room. She now sets the sphere down before listening. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Argument wiegt. Es wird nur auf ausdrücklichen Wunsch vorgetragen.

name: Lutz Luftlinie
personality: He measures success from the most flattering available edge.
visual_intent: Tall upright reverse-comma splat with high sweeping ink crest, smug one-raised-eyelid stare and crooked toothless smirk; small cream collar with rust edge; holds short rolled measuring tape with only blank marks, one hand pinching the end proudly
biography: He measures success from the most flattering available edge. His tape begins wherever his last result looks most impressive. HyperNorm calls that optimisation unless a neighbour does it. An ambiguous card about a fair starting point has made him measure the space left for everyone else. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Weite ist beachtlich. Der Anfang wurde entsprechend gewählt.

name: Viktor Vertikal
personality: He has achieved ambition and would now like a reliable way down.
visual_intent: Slender wavering upright blob, drooping curled crest, giant anxious eyes looking up, small gaping toothless mouth; tiny rust scarf; carries short thick bamboo pole upright at side, full pole inside cell, no jumping/scene
biography: He has achieved ambition and would now like a reliable way down. He carries the bamboo pole upright through a building that equates ambition with altitude. The approved categories are rising or disappointing. A dissonant card suggests that a safe return deserves its own applause, which is a considerable relief. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Aufstieg ist geklärt. Für unten fehlt noch ein Ansprechpartner.

name: Manni Morgennoch
personality: He believes the final kilometre is a renewable resource.
visual_intent: Wide asymmetrical pear blob, sunken weary lids and closed slack frown; faded cream cloth cap, tiny rust collar; dented enamel water flask in one hand, single little laurel twig tucked into cap, no floating sweat symbols
biography: He believes the final kilometre is a renewable resource. He carries an enamel flask and the quiet suspicion that perseverance has become somebody else's cost saving. HyperNorm records only finishing or failing. He now keeps a little water for residents whose journey has no official finish line. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der letzte Kilometer wurde erneut bestätigt.
